d:
John Ternus is out and Tim Cook is in. He's been at the helm of Apple since the passing of Steve Jobs in 2011. Tim now stepping down from the lead role to be replaced by a little known mechanical engineer. So what's next for Apple and what changes could we see under his leadership? In this episode we find out.
